items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I know all the greatest ones. Tommy Jackson.

ctx.x: Edward Hatchet. Because Eddie Boyd wasn't playing nothing then, when that Hatchet was... He was trying to play. I'm going to tell you who he was running with. Don't you know, the boy would play a drum, Willa Hood? Huh? Well he did. I used to miss around with his old lady, him. Willa Hood. Oh, we missed another piano player too. Holston the Inn, drummer. Holston. Holston's a good piano player. A good old piano player.

If you oughta know by some more good piano players, the one down further. I know all the greatest ones. Tommy Jackson. I will ask you later, excuse me. Tommy, brother, I'm a student. Oh, no. Oh, them guys.
